scoring_justification: Simulation cannot be rerun by lightweight checker; transition threshold is checked against paper-derived range and overstep is compared to ~2 kJ/mol. Structural checks on morphology table monotonicity and grid validity add supporting verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference overstep (2.0 kJ/mol) and plausible transition range [0.1, 3.0]
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text: 'estimated minimum overstep of ~2 kJ mol⁻¹ needed to produce branched growth for Φ₁/kT of 4 or more (Fig. DR3)'. Transition range based on parameter sweeps in Fig. DR3 and Figure 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper statements and figure annotations.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's primary quantitative conclusion; range is chosen to encompass plausible implementation variations.

outputs.description: Morphological descriptors (branch count, compactness) for each simulation run, used to verify the monotonic trend with decreasing supersaturation.
Estimated dimensionless supersaturation at the morphological transition (branching disappears), and optionally the equivalent overstep in kJ/mol.

schema.description: Space-separated 0/1 occupancy grid from the variable‑supersaturation run, row‑major order.

outputs.description: Final crystal occupancy grid from the time‑varying simulation, used to verify core–rim structural pattern.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run all simulations itself; no pre‑computed intermediate results are provided. The transition threshold is scored because it is the main quantitative result linking morphological change to supersaturation.

steps.description: Verify branch_count is non-decreasing with increasing Δμ/kT (monotonic trend expected from simulation)
Check transition Δμ/kT within plausible range [0.1, 3.0] and overstep close to 2 kJ/mol if provided
Validate file contains a rectangular 2D grid of 0/1 integers
